text: The problem with AI generated documentation is: you don’t know if it’s accurate/misleading because you don’t know if the docs have been reviewed before being published. With manual generated docs you at least know that someone put the effort to write something. So that effort counts for something. With AI you know that’s it’s perfectly possible to come up with dozens/hundreds of pages with a single prompt that takes zero effort to write. I don’t trust AI generated content by default
